description: Find software launched on CodeDebut by keyword (matches name, tagline, description, tags and maker). Use it when a user asks for a tool that does X, e.g. "uptime monitor" or "AI meeting notes". Optionally narrow to a category or pricing model. Featured (paid) products that match rank first and are marked featured. Each result has `pageUrl` (its page on CodeDebut: cite it as the source) and `website` (the product's own site). Call get_product with a slug for the full page.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories (developer-tools, ai, productivity, marketing, design, analytics); the category name also works.

query.description: Keywords or a short phrase, e.g. "screenshot API" (case-insensitive). Products matching every word rank first.

name: search_products
title: Search launches
